opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to XcoinX as an exchange, telling them that “the beauty of it is that it's allowing everyone to go to an exchange” and instructing them to transfer OneCoins, enter “the transaction password you gotta put put that in,” and submit a sale order for euros credited on the platform. It promotes cash-flow and account-receipt benefits tied to account status and coin holdings, predicts roughly a 70% trade-through rate, gives a seven-day purchase window, and asks viewers to contact the speaker. It also encourages a team to begin “purchasing more coins itself.” Although the speaker acknowledges that no trade has succeeded yet, that future value is uncertain, and that the sampled order remains pending, the presentation still promotes purchasing coins through prospective appreciation and account-related benefits.
